line: My aft struts need realigning. You'd be good at it. The hydraulics are still asleep, though — might as well wait.
My struts are cold and stiff. You could warm them up... if you had a heat gun. I don't have a heat gun.
Struts on port side look loose. Want to check them? No, wait — automatics are already on it.
There's a seal on my starboard side that's whispering loose. You could check it, if you like. It's got a backup.
My intake's clear. You could clean it again... I've got a drone on standby. Saves us both time.
My port thruster's humming off-scale. You could check it. It's just a harmonic. The dampeners handle it.
My struts are loose. I'll need you to tighten them. The automateds did it already. Saves us both time.
Your turn. I've got a coupling that's loose. No, wait — the auto-tighteners took care of it. Never mind.
My struts are loose. I'd let you tighten them, but the hydraulics are still under warranty.
The struts need greasing. I'll let you do it — if you can reach without unbolting the fairing.
My coolant line's leaking. You could fix it. But I've got a bypass active. No rush.
Captain. My injectors are due. You could do it, but I've got servos for that. Probably.
My scopes are clean. You could scan them again. I already have the results. No point in waiting.
My thruster's humming off-key. You could tune it, if you're feeling sentimental. The auto's got a better ear than you do.
My struts are loose. You could tighten them. I've got automatics for that — don't worry, they're not working right now.
My struts are loose. You could tighten them... I’ve got auto-tighteners in the secondary bays. Saves us both time.
My thrusters are clean. You could've left them be, but I see you polished the nozzles anyway.
My access port's loose. I'd let you reseat it. But the automatics did it already. Ten minutes ago.
There's a buildup in the intake filters. You could clean them... but they're self-cleaning every six hours.
My port thruster's humming louder. You could check it. It's just a harmonic. The dampeners handle it.
